title: Observer notifications
summary: An observer listens for a change. The subject tells its listeners when something happens.
introduction: An observer listens for a change. The subject tells its listeners when something happens. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: An observer listens for a change. The subject tells its listeners when something happens.

blocks.title: Observer notifications

blocks.text: The result is Score 8. The listener receives the new value.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Add a second listener that prints twice the score.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Remove listeners when they are no longer needed to avoid repeated work.
For more detail later, use this [Design Patterns further reading](https://refactoring.guru/design-patterns).
